58.value: Figure (3): two vertical lines and two horizontal lines
58.reasoning: Count the lines in each arm. Figure 1 has one vertical and one horizontal line. Figure 2 doubles the vertical lines (two vertical, one horizontal). The last figure has three vertical and two horizontal lines, so the steps take turns: vertical goes up, then horizontal goes up, then vertical again. The missing figure therefore has two vertical and two horizontal lines, which is Figure (3). Figure (4) has three horizontal lines, one too many.
